title: COP31 draft decision calls for tripling adaptation finance to $120B, speeding shift away from fossil fuels
description: Proposed climate deal urges developed countries to increase funding for developing nations by 2035, while Australian minister warns not all parties will agree on draft provisions

title: NASA Curiosity Gediz Vallis discovery: What do the yellow crystals found by Curiosity on Mars tell us about the planet's ancient history?
description: In a groundbreaking discovery, NASA’s Curiosity rover uncovered pure elemental sulfur in a fractured Martian rock in 2024. These unprecedented yellow crystals puzzled scientists, sparking two studies that speculate volcanic gases or watery chemical reactions might lead to such formations. The findings underscore Mars’ ancient conditions and enrich efforts to explore the planet's history, positioning Mars as a vital location for assessing potential extraterrestrial life.

title: COP31 draft deal urges faster fossil fuel phaseout, proposes $120 billion in climate finance
description: The first draft of a political agreement at COP31 calls for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels and triple climate adaptation finance for developing nations to at least $120 billion.

title: COP31 draft deal calls for 'accelerated action' to exit fossil fuels
description: COP31 co-host Australia released the first draft of a broad political deal Monday that includes a call for nations to speed up the phaseout of planet-heating coal, oil and gas.
